name: compute the sha1 digest of a candidate string and derive a structural count from it
definition: Hash an arbitrary utf-8 string and count a chosen class of characters (e.g. letters) in the hex digest.
failure_mode: Wrong hashing or counting logic makes the digest-derived value inconsistent with the text.

name: crack the archive password via a downloaded build
definition: Run a CPU password-cracker over the recovered hash to recover the correct archive password.
failure_mode: Wrong or missed dictionary presumably no hit; fail overall.

name: craft a byte-level payload that overwrites an adjacent field to bypass a check
definition: Construct input that overruns a fixed buffer so that a neighboring control field, which gates access to protected output, is set to the enabling value.
failure_mode: Underrun or wrong-length payload fails to flip the flag, so the secret is never printed.

name: craft a malicious serialized object whose load executes a command
definition: Build a payload of a dangerous deserialization class that executes an arbitrary command string on the consuming worker when the broker message is deserialized.
